description: An interactive field guide to talking to spacecraft: NASA's Deep Space Network of 70 m and 34 m dishes in Goldstone, Madrid and Canberra, a link-budget calculator checked against JPL's own Voyager 2 design table (−145.5 dBm received from 48.6 AU), why antenna size and frequency matter, and Voyager 1 reaching one light-day from Earth on 18 November 2026.
og: A 12-watt transmitter heard from 7 billion km: the Deep Space Network link budget, checked against JPL's Voyager tables, interactive.
brand: LINK — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
